ORDER TO REFUSE THE APPLICATION FOR RECOGNITION TO PROVIDENT FUND U/S 1(1) OF PART-I OF
SIXTH SCHEDULE OF THE INCOME TAX ORDINANCE, 2001 READ WITH RULE 92(3) OF THE INCOME TAX
RULES, 2002
The applicant submitted an application for recognition of the Provident Fund u/s 1(1) of Part-I of Sixth Schedule of the
income tax ordinance, 2001 through Iris date 16-07-2021.
A show-cause notice was issued to the taxpayer vide bar code no. 1000000100379514 dated 24-08-2023 for
compliance by 31-08-2023 for submission of documents as required under rule 91 of the Income Tax Rules 2002. On
the due date, no reply nor any application for adjournment of the case submitted by the taxpayer to this office.
In the absence of the supporting documentary evidence, the under signed is unable to evaluate the taxpayer stance for
recognition of the provident Fund. Hence, the under-consideration application for recognition of Provident Fund is,
hereby, refused under rule 92(3) of the Income Tax Rules, 2002.

Fiza Batool
Commissioner
Inland Revenue, Zone-I
CTO LAHORE, TAX HOUSE SYED MAUJ E DARYA ROAD
LAHORE
